ops.body: Nov 20: E-tabs-4 (`docs/expectations/tabs.md`, drafted by `/tend tabs`, the owner's "Ratify as drafted", decision 0243) is this entry's expectation: "a photo, a voice memo or a note, each one tap from the tab they are on while a walk records, to join that walk without leaving the tab". Judged failed in that run, its check pending. It passes only with the mic and the note both on the bar (this entry's Otherwise), not with the Recommended's mic alone, which leaves the note two taps away; the Recommended stands as filed. Since decision 0240 the bar's photo opens its editor by itself, on the tab it was taken from.

- **The tabs' rule files and `specs/v0.5-places/spec.md` quote words the build no longer says** (Nov 20; the owner's answers in person, "Rename the mark (Recommended)", "Minutes on the tabs (Recommended)" and "1:45", decision 0243; decision 0234). What ships: the empty peek reads "Walk somewhere and it is marked here" and "This walk is marked here when it ends" (`tend tabs 20`); the recording bar's line reads "< 1 min · 18 m · Paused", "1:05 · 1.5 km" past the hour (`tend tabs 21`, `tend tabs audit 55`); and the walk's settings have no mode since 0234, the "?" range showing always and What I'm into's row with Places or Sights on (`intoRowShown`). Still saying the old: `.claude/rules/tabs-and-home.md` l.116 ("This walk is starred here when it ends") and l.178-179 ("mode, destination, "?" range and the row to What I'm into's page (Explore only; decision 0192)"); `.claude/rules/recording-bar.md` l.27 ("paused it reads "0:05 · 18 m · Paused""); `specs/v0.5-places/spec.md` l.236 (criterion 19) and l.301 (H2), "Walk somewhere and it is starred here". The loop only adds to a rule file (0135) and never edits a spec; reword them by hand (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the steward's call 1 and the auditor's 7; its diff review, the steward's 5 and the ux-reviewer's 3).

- **`specs/navigation-and-tabs/spec.md` l.48 (NV9) still says "It has no Stop."** (Nov 20). What ships since decision 0048: the recording bar has its own held Stop (`bar-stop`), and since `tend tabs 18` the launch journey asks for it (its check had counted a testid the bar never carries, so "no Stop" held whatever the bar showed). Since `tend tabs 21` (decision 0243) its "elapsed time" is said in minutes. The spec mirrors the owner's doc: reword NV9 there and re-export (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the auditor's 3).

- [loop] The recording bar's way back is named "Return to the walk" twice to VoiceOver: `recording-return` (`components/RecordingBar.tsx` l.263-267) carries `accessibilityHint="Returns to the walk"` while its line's spoken label already ends "Return to the walk" (`recordingLine().label`, `lib/recordingBar.ts`); and while the bar's words (`recording-said`) stand in for the line, the name loses "Return to the walk" altogether. react-native-web drops the hint, so only a phone says it. Fix: drop the hint, and end the said words' label with "Return to the walk". Low (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the auditor's 5, Nov 20; HIG VoiceOver: a hint is not the label again). Test: `tend tabs N: the bar's way back says "Return to the walk" once, said words or not` (unit, a source scan)

- [loop] The bar's way back waits on a tapped reminder's write with no bound: `back()` (`components/RecordingBar.tsx` l.183) awaits `db.setMeta(RECALL_OPEN_KEY, …)` while `returning.current` is set, so a write stuck in the device's queue leaves the › doing nothing until it lands; its photo wait is bounded (`settleWithin(keeping.current, RETURN_WAIT_MS)`). Fix: `settleWithin(db.setMeta(…), RETURN_WAIT_MS)`. Low (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the auditor's 6, Nov 20; it touches the bar's only `db` import, which the RECALL_OPEN_KEY item above also turns on). Test: `tend tabs N: a reminder's write that hangs holds the bar's way back no longer than its wait` (unit, a source scan)

- [loop] `components/StartSettings.tsx` still reads as if the walk had a mode: its comment (l.28-34) says "Mode and destination first; Explore's range and the row to What I'm into's page (decision 0192) only with Explore chosen", and l.67-79 keep the condition's leftover `{( <> … </> )}` around the "?" range and Passing a place, which now show always (decision 0234). Nothing behind it reads a mode. Fix: the comment says what shows (the destination, the leanings, the range and passing always, What I'm into's row by `intoRowShown`), and the fragment goes. Low (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the auditor's 7 and the steward's call 1, Nov 20; the rule line's twin is in STATUS.md, "Open before the loop"). Test: `tend tabs N: StartSettings' comment names no mode` (unit, a source scan)

- [loop] An error in the tabs' own layout leaves a recording walk with no way to it: `(tabs)/_layout.tsx` l.29 exports `HomeScreenError` (exit `none`, Try again alone, `tend replay audit 8`), and a throw there (the tab bar, the recording bar) replaces both bars, so with a walk recording there is no Stop and no way back to the walk but a relaunch, which the launch cover then brings up (Nielsen H3, user control and freedom). Not pictured: no journey can make the layout itself throw without a hook in the app (the maps a journey refuses throw inside a tab, whose own boundary keeps both bars). Recommended next: picture it first with a test-only throw, then, if it holds, a secondary button to the walk while one is open, which adds a control (the owner's). Low (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the ux-reviewer's 2, medium provisional, filed low as not pictured, Nov 20). Test: `tend tabs N: the tabs' layout error with a walk open offers a way to it` (e2e)

- [loop] A weak test: `tabs audit U13` (`src/lib/__tests__/tabs/tabsAuditQuiet.test.ts` l.24-29, "a walks list row keeps distance and time, and counts no new streets") asserts only `doesNotMatch(meta, /new street/)`, so a row that said "3 streets new to you", the card's own clause, would pass. Fix: assert the row is exactly date, distance, time and captures (`walkRowMeta`'s shape), with no "street" at all. Low (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the auditor's list of weak tests, Nov 20; its other two, `screenErrorExit`'s unchecked body and `barWayBack` l.62's core-only check, are answered by `tend tabs 16` and `tend tabs 19`). Test: `tend tabs N: a walks list row says nothing of streets` (unit)

- [owner] Should "opening the app reads nothing of where you are" (HC14, `capturehome`'s "HC14: opening on Chronicle reads no location") be one of tabs' expectation lines, given VISION's Never "All-day tracking" and "one fix per moment" (0036)? Tabs holds five, the most in force (0236). Low (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the steward's silent 3, Nov 20)

- Measured (`/tend tabs`, Nov 20, a probe at 320 x 700 and 390 x 700): the five chips are 44 px tall and 4 px apart at both widths, Media 8 px from the right edge; at 320 they are 83, 56, 49, 45 and 57 px wide, so 8 px gaps would need 338 px, more than the screen: the gap can only grow if the chips' own padding shrinks (Map is 45, a pixel above the 44 pt floor).

Nov 20 (`/tend tabs`'s lenses, the ux-reviewer's 3, low): with a walk minimized and the bar's Edit pill up, the foot of Memories at 320 x 700 was four layers (the pill, the open line, the recording bar, the tab bar), about 35% of the screen (`tabs-T12-pill-on-memories-320`). Since decision 0240 the pill is gone; the storage notice, when it shows, still adds a fourth.

argv: peek's line, "Walk somewhere and it is starred here"
decision 0243: the empty peek says "marked here" (tend tabs 20; the diff review's auditor 5)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone with nothing walked, open Chronicle's Map, then start a walk, keep a memo and minimize it. **Expect:** with nothing open, the peek's line, "Walk somewhere and it is marked here", sits whole on its own row above Navigate alone, and the peek opens at its own height (`tend tabs 7`); with the walk minimized, the line reads "This walk is marked here when it ends", whole, with no button, and the recording bar's › goes back to the walk (`tend tabs T10`, decision 0148).

argv: peek's line, "This walk is starred here when it ends"
decision 0243: the empty peek says "marked here" (tend tabs 20; the diff review's auditor 5)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone at the largest text size, with nothing walked and a walk minimized, open Chronicle's Map. **Expect:** the peek's line, "This walk is marked here when it ends", sits whole under the grabber; the peek is the plain 76 pt with no button, and a line that wraps to two at a large size may be clipped (the header is 48 pt; the T10 review's native notes; see T13).

**Nov 20, `/tend tabs --deploy=main`, a whole, uncapped sweep** (opened from `805895f4`, rebased on `fcd57a9c`; lenses 0-7 all run; the third of decision 0229's whole sweeps, the third under the expectation lens, decision 0236).
- Lens 0: tabs had no line; five drafted (`docs/expectations/tabs.md`, proposed), reworded by the steward and answered by the owner in person ("Ratify as drafted", decision 0243). E-tabs-1, 2, 3 and 5 met by their journey checks on the final build (capturehome HC1, reload HC2, launch NV8 with "the bar is on every tab", tabs audit 3); E-tabs-4 failed, its check pending, its defect T11 (noted there: it passes only with the mic and the note both, T11's Otherwise).
- Lenses: 1, the area's journeys (`tabs`, `reload`, `launch`, `capturehome`) to the ux-reviewer and the steward; 2-4 read from the code, the specs and the rule files; 5, the auditor; 6, `check:vision --list` clean on the area's files; 7, DEFERRED's ten `[loop]` items of the area read (the section chips measured: 4 px apart at 320 and 390).
- Shipped: `tend tabs 16` the tabs' error screens say what the open walk is, or nothing with none open (the owner's O35 extension; a day, What I'm into and `/chronicle` follow as the run's call); `17` the launch journey's render bound reads Memories, where the tour ends (`render:navigate` was counted nowhere); `18` the launch journey looks for the bar's own held Stop; `19` a stop that never settles lets the bar's Stop go after its bound (built again on main's bar after 0240); `20` the empty peek says "marked here", not "starred"; `21` the bar says the time in minutes; `22` the bar's reminder card is pictured.
- The review (one round; the auditor, the ux-reviewer and the steward; accepted 12, deferred 0, to the owner 2, both answered, rejected 0): `audit 53` a hold past a stop's bound joins the walk's end under way, one replay pushed; `54` a bar mounted after the bound draws its Stop at rest; `55` past the hour the bar reads "1:05 · 1.5 km" (the owner: "1:45"); `56` the bar says the time it draws; `57` the bar draws its numbers whole and only " · Paused" shrinks; `58` a replay's error says "saved" only while no other walk records (the owner: "Nothing while one records"); `59`-`61` this run's weak tests made real; `62` ScreenError's comment credits the owner with the tabs alone. The walk screen's strip keeps its own clock (it rounds past ten minutes; the bar floors).
- The owner's answers in person (decision 0243): the lines as reworded; "Yes, 'still recording'"; "Rename the mark"; "Minutes on the tabs"; "1:45"; "Nothing while one records".
- Filed besides: `[loop]` lows in "Tabs and the recording bar" (the bar's way back said twice to VoiceOver, its reminder write unbounded, StartSettings' mode words, the tabs' layout error with a walk recording, a weak U13 test) and an `[owner]` low (HC14 as a line); a note on T11; the rule files' and `specs/v0.5-places/spec.md`'s stale quotes and NV9's "It has no Stop." in "Open before the loop"; two NATIVE_UNVERIFIED checks reworded to "marked".
- The balance: outgrowing its base (ten areas rough); no `G` from lens 0 (E-tabs-4's growth is T11, open). The area stays `rough`: an older medium (Chronicle's two controls for one choice) stays in DEFERRED.
- Journeys on the final build: launch, tabs, reload, capturehome.
